subject: general
question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

Do you think it is going to ______ this afternoon?
solution:
The correct answer is '**rain**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**rain**" refers to water droplets falling from the sky as precipitation. (बारिश)
 
• In the context of the question, the weather-related term "rain" fits perfectly to complete the sentence.
 
• The other options: "**reign**," "**raign**," and "**rein**" do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Do you think it is going to rain__ this afternoon?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Reign (शासन)**: refers to the period during which a sovereign rules.
 
• **Raign**: This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a valid meaning.
 
• **Rein (लगाम)**: refers to a strap used to control a horse or metaphorically to control or restrain something.
